headline: Case brief — password-reset link expiry on Chrome 128
body: Customer hit two expired reset links after forced token rotation. Confirm single-use token TTL and browser clock skew before drafting the AI reply.
author: Ava Agent

headline: Macro — force-expire prior reset tokens and resend
body: Expire all outstanding password-reset tokens for the account, issue one fresh link, and ask the customer to complete reset within fifteen minutes.
author: Sam Supervisor

headline: SLA note — double-charge refund within one business day
body: Billing critical path: confirm invoice #4821 duplicate charge, reverse one line, and email corrected receipt before end of next business day.
author: Bella Billing

headline: Escalation plan — route refund to Billing Ops lead
body: If refund API is slow, page Billing Ops lead and attach ledger export; do not leave critical priority open past SLA without a named owner.
author: Eli Escalations

headline: Case brief — prod API key 401 after Tuesday deploy
body: Staging key still works; prod returns 401 since key-rotation race in Tuesday deploy. Hotfix window before standup; rotate affected production keys after merge.
author: Ava Agent

headline: Macro — request Okta SAML tracer for ACS mismatch
body: Ask IT for SAML tracer export, confirm ACS URL matches tenant metadata, and schedule metadata patch the same day when 40 seats are blocked.
author: Sam Supervisor

headline: Resolution letter — overnight webhook 502 retry cleared
body: Outbound CRM webhooks recovered after edge gateway restart; retry queue drained. Customer notified with delivery timestamps and monitoring link.
author: Ava Agent

headline: Case brief draft — CSV export timeout on 50k rows
body: Spinner exceeds ten minutes then blank page. Capture project id, row count, and browser console; prefer async export job design notes before customer-facing ETA.
author: Ava Agent

headline: SLA note — feature request dark mode triage window
body: Low-priority feature request: acknowledge within two business days, log system-preference toggle preference, no commit to ship date until product triage.
author: Sam Supervisor

headline: Escalation plan — platform eng owns key rotation hotfix
body: Platform eng owns the hotfix PR; support only rotates keys after green deploy. Page on-call if 401 persists more than thirty minutes post-merge.
author: Eli Escalations
